Only selected GTDB blocks/statuses/options and new native events may change. AS broth contains organic nutrients; bulk substrate/COD changes and ammonia production do not establish complete mineralization, consortium ammonia removal, interspecies flux or reciprocal benefit. Preserve 37 degrees Celsius suspended C1-C5, 24/48/72-hour Table 2 endpoints, monoculture kinetics and C5/C6 growth profiles as distinct evidence. Do not transfer C6 biofilm, gamma irradiation or immobilized per-carrier values to C1-C5. Preserve existing empty causal edge lists and the single COMMUNITY_LEVEL node per record. GTDB reference populations and option counts are unrelated to equal-ratio inoculation, viable-cell numbers or removal percentages. Do not infer a verified crosswalk release from file mtime. Keep differing GTDB and NCBI names explicit without renaming study stocks.
